svg.aria-label: Hub templates: the Policy syslog-target reads a value per cluster from the ConfigMap cluster-settings in acm-policies. The propagator resolves the hub template for every selected cluster, so the replicated policy for sno contains syslog-eu.example.com and the one for bm syslog-us.example.com; each managed cluster applies its own value.
svg.title: Hub templates: the Policy syslog-target reads a value per cluster from the ConfigMap cluster-settings in acm-policies. The propagator resolves the hub template for every selected cluster, so the replicated policy for sno contains syslog-eu.example.com and the one for bm syslog-us.example.com; each managed cluster applies its own value.
svg.text: {{hub … hub}} is resolved on the hub, per cluster, before the policy is distributed. Templates without "hub" are resolved on the managed cluster.
Hub templates can only read objects in the namespace of the policy (unless hubTemplateOptions.serviceAccountName is set).
